name: human-fleet-growth
notes: Human AI step 2 (user, 2026-10-19: fix the bottleneck they're stuck on, bigger hulls, queue unblocking). Vanilla 2039 (3 runs): AI human factions stall at 1-5k SCV each while the player has 11-13k; summed AI human SCV 17.8k -> 21.0k in a year (x1.18) at ~55 SCV per ship. Measured bottlenecks (2034 diagnostic): generic MC 0 (Academy, Exodus), metals 0 (Initiative), $15-54k idle money, small hulls. v1 (2026-10-19): growth x1.13/x1.12, 52/42 SCV per ship: no gain. Generic MC 0 all year for 5 of 6 factions (habs consume it); money $65-147k, boost 1.6-4.5k idle. v2 adds MC buildings on developed habs and a fleet MC reserve against new founding (user: grow MC much harder and reserve it for the fleet).
